_comment: Form branding configuration. Map Enketo form IDs to custom images.
_usage: Add an entry with the form's Enketo ID (from the URL, e.g. 'boFXa8gH') and set banner/thankyou images.
_banner_upload: Place banner images in /custom-static/config/banners/ and reference by filename.
_thankyou_upload: Place thank-you logos in /custom-static/config/thankyou/ and reference by filename.

defaults.thankyou_message: Your submission has been recorded successfully. Thank you for contributing to urban resilience data collection.

boFXa8gH.thankyou_message: Your submission has been recorded successfully. Thank you for submitting the form as part of the LVBWB mapping activities.
